matcha.role: Matcha: retrieval, embedding similarity, the rank

finn.role: Finn: weights, the synthesized track, anything downstream of the blend

ink.role: all text, axes, ticks, track baselines (print black)

muted.role: secondary text: in-panel annotations, threshold labels, context names

slate.role: neutral data: the baseline method, non-hit bars, unranked points

rule.role: hairlines, ghost points, Other tissue, bands, nulls and floors

red.role: the one red: the query mark

hit.role: a same-context hit in a ranked list

case.role: rose: the disease / case arm, always

control.role: teal: the healthy / control arm when it is compared; slate when it is context
